text:
joel: Customer 'acme-ops' reporting 403 on SSO after their IdP did a cert rotation this morning. Error in our logs: 'Assertion recipient invalid'. They say metadata URL returns 200 but maybe still has old key. Can someone triage?

support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-4999, paging oncall. Please add repro steps and any logs.

ingrid: Can you paste the metadata URL + a curl of it and the exact ACS they're posting to? Also attach the SP debug log snippet if available.

joel: metadata: https://idp.acme.internal/metadata (customer-managed). ACS: https://redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-ops
Here's curl output I grabbed from a customer VM:
```
$ curl -sI https://idp.acme.internal/metadata
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/xml
ETag: "v2-abc123"

$ curl https://idp.acme.internal/metadata | head -n 5
<md:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.acme.internal">
  <md:IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <ds:KeyInfo>
        <ds:X509Data>
          <ds:X509Certificate>MIIFOLD_CERT_OLD...</ds:X509Certificate>
        </ds:X509Data>
      </ds:KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>\n```
Customer says the IdP rotated to MIIF_NEW_CERT... earlier today.

michael: Two things to check: our metadata-poller/watchdog and any CDN/edge caching in front of the customer's IdP. The poller uses an If-None-Match/ETag heuristic; we recently changed behavior to trust 304s from CDNs, but some IdPs are fronted by a caching proxy that returns a stale 200 with old body + new ETag — bad combo. Run the internal check: `rwd-saml-check --tenant acme-ops --metadata-url https://idp.acme.internal/metadata`

joel: ran it -> output:
```
$ rwd-saml-check --tenant acme-ops --metadata-url https://idp.acme.internal/metadata
poller: last_polled=4999981000
poller: fetched_etag="v2-abc123"
metadata-fingerprint: SHA1=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:FF:11:22:33:44 (OLD)
idp-advertised-fingerprint: SHA1=11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00 (NEW)
result: no-update-applied (ETag matched, body fingerprint mismatch)
```
So poller recorded same ETag as before and skipped the update despite a body mismatch.

ingrid: that matches my suspicion — our poller has a 304/ETag edge-case where it trusts ETag/304 without validating body hash when an ETag is present. Customer's CDN returned a 200 with stale body but bumped ETag (ugh). We need to remediate now: temporary workaround is to manually upload the new cert to the tenant's SAML keys so SP accepts assertions.

joel: attempted admin API upload: POST /admin/tenants/acme-ops/saml/keys with payload {"cert": "MIIF_NEW_CERT...", "use":"signing"} -> returned 202 Accepted.

support-bot: Cache invalidation queued for tenant acme-ops. TTL flush scheduled in 30s.

oncall: Flushed the SAML cache for acme-ops and forced a poll: `systemctl restart metadata-poller && rwd-saml-check ...` After that I tried a login from reproducer and got: HTTP 302 -> our SSO flow -> success. Sample SP log lines:
```
[4999994338] SAML: Received assertion for tenant=acme-ops, assertion_id=abcd-1234
[4999994338] SAML: Verified signature using fingerprint 11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00
[4999994338] SAML: recipient match OK for https://redwood.com/sso/acs/acme-ops
[4999994338] auth: SUCCESS user=jane.doe@acme
```
So the manual key upload + cache flush fixed immediate logins.

michael: Root cause summary to include in ticket: IdP rotated signing cert, metadata feed was behind a CDN/proxy that produced inconsistent ETag/body combos. Our metadata-poller incorrectly used ETag/304 heuristic and skipped applying the new key when the ETag matched but body fingerprint changed. Action items: 1) patch poller to always verify body fingerprint when ETag changes OR when fingerprint header present; 2) add a watchdog check that compares published fingerprint vs last-applied and alerts on mismatch; 3) doc for support runbooks (manual key upload + cache flush) for customer-facing triage.

joel: I'll open a postmortem ticket and include communications for acme-ops support rep. I've flagged this as P2 and CC'd infra.

ingrid: Add mitigation for future rotations: we can accept short-lived fallback key (customer uploads new cert pre-rotation as 'upcoming') — quick win.

oncall: Marking incident resolved for now :white_check_mark:. Will follow up with a deploy for poller fix in next patch.

joel: Thanks all — leaving notes for support handoff. Closing thread once postmortem doc is attached.
